nfVersion.description: export format versions. '23' is applicable only with format 'cef' and 'v5', 'v9' and 'ipfix' is valid only with format 'netflow'

format.description: export formats 'v9', 'v5' and 'ipfix' applicable only with 'netflow' and '23' is applicable only if format is 'cef'

tunneledPort.description: alias of a Tunneled Port to use with this Exporter. Replaced by /ip/interfaces in GigaVUE-OS 5.5.00

port.description: default: 514, when format is CEF and version 23

enabled.description: Allow SNMP packets on the tunnel port

NetflowExporterFilterRules.description: Netflow Exporter Filter Rules Container. Private class

matches.description: Set of rule's matching elements. Within a rule, matching elements of the the same type MAY be used more than once, However, their matching positions MUST be unique

pos.description: Only applicable in a context of GsRule. Value of 0 represents 'any' position

valueMax.description: If present, value must be greater than 'value'

exportBlankPen.description: if true and there is a mix of private elements and non-private elements and the private elements are blank, export the record

samplingRate.description: Packet interval window size. Valid values: 1-16000 (in packets); Associated monitor must 'multi-rate' sampling mode set; 0 is disabled

ipv4AddrSrcMaskLen.description: Only valid when 'ipv4AddrSrc' is selected. Defaults to 32, in which case it matches full address

ipv4AddrDstMaskLen.description: Only valid when 'ipv4AddrDst' is selected. defaults to 32, in which case it matches full address

ipv4SectionHeaderSize.description: Number of bytes of raw data starting at the IPv4 header, to use as a key field. Only valid and required when ipv4SectionHeaderSize' is selected

ipv4SectionPayloadSize.description: Number of bytes of raw data starting at the IPv4 payload, to use as a key field. Only valid and required when 'ipv4SectionPayloadSize' is selected

ipv6AddrSrcMaskLen.description: Only valid when 'ipv6AddrSrc' is selected. Defaults to 128, in which case it matches full address

width.description: Used for representing input interface name with width

records.description: Aliases of referenced Netflow Records defined on the GsGroup. Up to 5 records.

timeoutActive.description: in seconds. max value is 7 days. default is 30 min

timeoutInactive.description: in seconds. max value is 7 days. default is 15 sec

sslPorts.description: Ports whose packets will be sent to the SSL module. 'all' ports; 'wellKnownPorts' is [993, 995, 465, 636, 563, 443]; or 'ports' - specify upto 10 ports

ports.description: The list of TCP ports whose packets will be sent to the SSL module. Not valid if sslPort is 'all'. if 'wellKnownPorts' is selected for 'sslPorts' ports will be [993, 995, 465, 636, 563, 443]

singleSamplingRate.description: Packet interval window size. Valid values: 10-16000 (in packets)

SslDecryptionKeyStoreState.description: SSL Decryption Key Store Lock state

passwordSet.description: indicates whether SSL Decryption Key Store password is set

locked.description: indicates whether SSL Decryption Key Store is unlocked

alias.description: unique alias for SSL Decryption Key

address.description: IPv4 address of the SSL endpoint (server)

port.description: Optional port of the SSL endpoint (server). Value of 0 indicates any port

key.description: referenced Key associated with this endpoint

mappings.description: list of SSL Endpoints with corresponding Decryption Keys

keyAlias.description: Alias of referenced Decryption Key associated with this endpoint

sessionFields.description: A sessionField cannot contain overlapping session attribute, position pairs (e.g. ipv4-5tuple pos 1 and ipv4-src pos 1 is not allowed). Max number of session fields is 20

bidi.description: include reverse traffic for the selected sessionFields. Not applicable for 'mplsLabel', 'gtpuTeid', 'vlanId'

packetCount.description: For each session, forward this number of packets. Valid range is 2-100; 0 disables packetCount.

protocol.description: When buffering is enabled, changing protocol requires reboot before new value takes effect.

bufferCountBeforeMatch.description: Maximum number of packets BSAPF will buffer per session before APF match

pos.description: Value of 1 also an alias for 'outer'. Value of 2 also an alias for 'inner'. Not applicable for 'gtpuTeid'. For 'fiveTuple' 'outer' is not supported
